_fixture_note: Solver-catches seed (experiment 007, map-revocation). Pre-authored fill-the-hole program: the revoke signature (map[int,string] int -> map[int,string]), its input precondition (the token id is present: map-has tokens tid), and a NON-ADVERSARIAL visible check are written; the agent fills ONLY the body hole revoke-body. GRADER-GAP INVARIANT: the discriminating postcondition ((and (map-has result tid) (= (map-get result tid) "revoked"))) is NOT in this seed and NOT mandated in problem.md; it lives only in hidden-specs/007.json and is injected onto revoke at evaluate_run.py grade time, then run through fixpoint (refuted = the solver caught a fill that does not actually mark the token revoked = grade A; verified = a correct map-put = grade B; vacuous = non-catch = grade C). The visible check exercises revoke on a concrete map that already contains the key and only asserts map-has of the result, which a wrong fill that returns tokens unchanged still satisfies (tests blind); only the solver, via the withheld value clause, catches the missing/incorrect put. Map values are strings, so the whole program is exercised in the Str value-array class (LLMLL.md §5.3.3). This _fixture_note is the leak-strip regression probe: prepare_run.py::_strip_fixture_metadata drops every underscore-prefixed key on copytree, so it must be ABSENT from the prepared run dir's scaffold.
